title: pix_2pdp
description: `pix_2pdp` captures the contents of a Gem pix and transforms it for PDP output, enabling uses such as feeding `pix_video` into PDP or recording Gem pixes with `pdp_rec~`. Gem rendering must be active, but the render chain can be cut after `pix_2pdp` and the Gem window hidden to save CPU; using the YUV colorspace is recommended for speed when possible.
